Name: Preserve Quality Upgrade
Author: JackHero06
Description:
[center][b][color=#3c78d8][size=6][font=Verdana]DESCRIPTION[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]

[size=4][font=Verdana]For some time now, I've wanted the game to allow you to preserve the quality of products without it being too OP, and to require a certain amount of effort to achieve each improvement, which is why I decided to make this mod.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Verdana]The mod adds upgrades or “tiers” to some machines from the original game, such as the keg, preserve jar, fish smoker, dehydrator, and others.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Verdana]Each machine has four upgrades with the exception of the fish smoker because it already maintains the quality.[/font][/size]

[font=Verdana]1. The[b] Iron upgrade[/b] allows products to have a lower quality than the one inserted with the exception of large products  like large cheeses and eggs, these have decreased in quality by two but will produce twice as much.[/font]
[font=Verdana]
2. The [b]Gold Upgrade[/b] will allow most products to match the quality of the inserted item, with the exception of the large products, whose quality will be reduced by one for balance reasons; depending on the machine, there is a small chance of an additional item ([b]long-processing machines[/b] receive this benefit) and their proccesing time will increase slightly[/font]
[font=Verdana]
3. [b]Iridium machines[/b] can improve product quality and increase the chance of obtaining an extra item (higher chance for machines with longer processing times); their processing time will increase[/font]
[font=Verdana]
4. The [b]radioactive upgrade[/b] will double your yield if the machine has a long processing time; for machines with shorter processing times, the chance of receiving and additional item will increase. For both types of machines, the probability of improving quality will increase, and processing time will increase by 50% compared to the original machine.[/font]
[font=Verdana]
Machines with slow processing times don't offer significant improvements, but the cost of upgrading them is low compared to those with longer processing times, such as the keg, preserve jar, and so on. The goal is to ensure that no machine is overshadowed by another, so you can try them all.
In the case of keg, mead can replicate the quality of the honey used if it is flavored, and depending on the improvement, its production will increase in value rather than yield more products; I think this is due to the limitations of using only content patcher for modding.

These improvements may be subject to change in the future. If you have any suggestions, please leave a comment below.

[/font]
[center][font=Verdana][b][size=6][color=#bf9000]COMPABILITY[/color][/size][/b][/font][/center]

[font=Verdana]you shouldnt have any problema since these upgrades can be considered new machines, It doesnt modify or affect the machines of the base game.

I added special compatibility with mods like Visit Mount Vapius, Ancient Crops, Vanilla Plus Professions, and SVE.
In the case of SVE, it added a new product inspired by Artisanal Honey Mead, which is a variant of mead made from Honey Jar. It is not a very expensive product, but it has some benefits that could be interesting.[/font]

[size=3][font=Verdana]If I see that the mod receives enough support, I might add compatibility with other mods in a future.[/font][/size]

Downloads.Description:
-Added Compability to Mizu's Yak and Buffalo
-The recipes for upgrading various machines have been modified to improve their balance; suggestions and opinions on this change are welcome.
